# Azure Search

Use installed `azdata[search]` v4; import from `azdata`. Read the
[canonical Search guide](../../../libraries/azure-data-connectors/docs/skills/azure-search.md)
for native index definitions, query/CRUD requests, item outcomes, readback,
authorization, errors, limits and lifecycle. The `azure_search` runtime is retired.
This entry contains no client or MCP server and grants no cloud or model access.
